name: ingle-plugin-secret-input
description: A masked secret card: the owner's value goes straight to the secret store, and the model only learns its name.

secret-input.title: Secret input
secret-input.description: secret.provide: stores the owner's value for an open secret card and answers it with the name only.

tool-secret-input.title: Secret input tools
tool-secret-input.description: request_secret: a deferred tool that shows the owner a masked input and ends the turn. Disable to hide it; secret.provide keeps answering open cards.
